adjudication.rationale: The client-side schema in `AddGuestsDialog.tsx` validates `multiEmailValue` with `z.array(z.string().email()).refine(...)`, enforcing both valid emails and uniqueness, but the server-side input schema `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.schema.ts` only enforces `z.array(z.string().email())` and does not enforce uniqueness. The handler also does not dedupe `guests` within the input list (it only filters against existing attendees/blacklist), so duplicate emails can pass server validation and reach `createMany`, causing inconsistent behavior vs the UI (and potential insertion errors depending on DB constraints).
